messages:
ryan: quick follow from today

ryan: two Qs for clarity: 1) timeline for merit increases (when do ICs actually see the money?) 2) someone asked if equity cliffs are changing for bootcamp hires — is that happening?

molly (People Ops): hi @ryan! short answers: merits post-calibration go into the next payroll run (usually 1 pay period; can be 2 if after cutoff). no company-wide change to equity cliffs right now — still 1y cliff + monthly after.

zack: managers keep getting asked whether off-cycle promos are retroactive. what's the standard?

molly (People Ops): promos are effective on the approved effective date. retro pay is only for admin errors or missed calibration; managers must submit the retro form within 30 days. details: <https://hr.redwood.company/forms/promo-retro>

ina: curious: will recruiting switch all candidate-facing docs to the new band names this week? got a candidate confused today.

molly (People Ops): recruiting has a sweep today. internal calibration still uses numeric grades until the formal cutover. we'll share a mapping table shortly.

peopleops-bot: Reminder: People Ops office hours tomorrow 11:00 AM PT — add to calendar <https://calendar.redwood.company/peopleops-officehours> :bell:

ryan: thanks! i'll drop this in the manager channel and encourage folks to join office hours.
